long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Turin in 1966, Berdusco developed a practice spanning Italy and Luxembourg. His work has focused on corporate and commercial law for regulated vehicles, including funds, funds of funds and securitisations. In Luxembourg, he has served as a manager or director of several holding and financial companies, including Distress to Value.

At Kinetika, Berdusco served as board chairman as the company managed residential elder care, disability services and psychiatric rehabilitation in northern Italy. The business operated through a Luxembourg parent, Halcor, where he was also a manager. He separately chaired Fonsicar, a Luxembourg risk-capital investment company, and remains listed as a lawyer in Luxembourg.
